questions.Description:
DESIGN A MUSEUM IN A CULTURALLY RICH TOWN. THE BUILDING SHOULD INCLUDE:
-- ENTRANCE LOBBY
-- GALLERY AND DISPLAY AREAS
-- ADMIN OFFICE
-- MULTIPURPOSE HALL
-- CAFE AND RESTROOMS
-- OUTDOOR INTERACTION SPACE

DESIGN AN EXHIBITION CENTRE THAT ACCOMMODATES:
-- ENTRANCE FOYER
-- LARGE AND SMALL DISPLAY HALLS
-- FLEXIBLE GALLERY SPACE
-- SEMINAR HALL
-- RESTROOMS
-- CAFE/FOOD KIOSK

DESIGN A MULTI STOREY SHOPPING CENTRE THAT INCLUDES:
(MINIMUM 4 FLOORS)
-- RETAIL OUTLETS
-- ANCHOR STORE
-- FOOD COURT
-- ENTERTAINMENT AREA (E.G., MULTIPLEX OR ARCADE)
-- SERVICE AREAS AND PARKING

DESIGN A 4-STOREY BUSINESS HOTEL INCLUDING: (MINIMUM 4 FLOORS)
-- RECEPTION/LOBBY
-- GUEST ROOMS (TYPES OF ROOMS: SINGLE, DOUBLE, SUITE )
-- RESTAURANT
-- BANQUET HALL
-- SERVICE AREAS AND VERTICAL CIRCULATION
-- PARKING
